rationale: I read the complete held EO 8226 original (4 FR 3722): one paragraph amending section 15 of EO 7845 (annual leave of Government employees), effective as of June 30, 1939; the held page also carries neighbouring EO 8225 and EO 8227, which I did not treat as part of this order. I read the held EO 8384 text (5 FR 1253, annual-leave regulations), and the same section also appears in the held 5 FR 1256 file (EO_8385.txt), which is the page-overlap source of ACT:EO:8226>EO:8385. Its Sec. 21 states 'This order shall supersede Executive Orders No. 7845 of March 21, 1938, No. 7879 of May 9, 1938, and No. 8226 of August 24, 1939' effective as of March 2, 1940. EO 8226 named by number and date is therefore expressly superseded in whole; it was only an amendment of a section of EO 7845, which is itself superseded by the same sentence, so no residual operative content remains. EO 8384 contains no savings clause for EO 8226; Sec. 20 ratifies temporary departmental regulations under EO 7321 and revokes inconsistent regulations, which concerns other instruments. The catalog note 'Revoked by: EO 8384' is consistent but only a lead. The older machine event from EO 7845 (amended by this order) is unrelated to ending. I found no earlier ending in the held record. Lifecycle details (exact effective-date chronology, any earlier statutory change) remain gaps; this is only a provisional NO hypothesis for owner consideration.
